function.name: look
function.description: Adjust the viewing angle of the camera to a specific orientation defined by yaw and pitch values in radians. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

pitch.description: The angle in radians to point up or down. 0 radians means straight forward. Positive values up to pi/2 radians mean pointing upwards, and negative values down to -pi/2 radians mean pointing downwards. This is a float type value.

yaw.description: The angle in radians for rotation around the vertical axis, starting from due east and rotating counter-clockwise. This is a float type value.
